set.body:
Objective
The single user-facing transform value, keyed by capability so push/pull cannot drift.

Authority and inputs
Plan: docs/plans/spatial-transform-parity.md (D3). Reader map: docs/plans/spatial-transform-parity-epic.md. References: ~/code/neurotransform (kernel/format parity), ~/code/neurofunctor (graph/operator parity). R packages are references, not APIs to copy.

Owner role and starting seams
transform; scalafim.transform. Bounded candidates, not reservations; reserve exact paths when beginning.

Prerequisite packets
Native mote blocking edges are authoritative; see docs/plans/spatial-transform-parity-epic.md.

Acceptance
1. WorldTransform {Linear(FramedAffine[T,S]), Smooth(SmoothIso[T,S]), Mapped(pull, PushAvailability)}; PushAvailability {FromAsset, Unavailable} (Estimated added in P6.02).
2. Linear.inverse delegates to FramedAffine.inverse; Linear andThen Linear fuses via AffineMap.operator and is statically Linear; other compositions lazy reframe4s.
3. mapPoint only where push exists; Mapped without push -> Left(NoForwardMap).
4. resample(image, onto: GridSpec[T], interp) expands to one reframe4s ResamplingPlan; default CoordinateBoundaryPolicy.Reject.
5. Affine build/decompose delegated to reframe4s-lie (missing parameterisations filed upstream).

Verification
Bounded sbt batches: <module>JVM/test then <module>JS/test for touched modules; scalafimCompileAll warning-clean.

Scope and handoff
Implement only this packet plus its owner-local tests/docs. Respect the authority ledger (docs/plans/image-module-unification-hardening.md) and the imageAlgebraBoundaryCheck forbidden names (no SpatialMorphism/Affine3DMorphism/IdentityMorphism/DenseFieldInverse/JacobianField/JacobianMode etc.). Generic transform/warp math belongs in reframe4s, geometry in image4s, linear algebra in Gale; ScalaFIM keeps neuroimaging policy and adapters. Every change compiles and passes on JVM and JS, run in bounded sbt batches (never scalafimTestAll in one shot); keep scalafimCompileAll warning-clean. Stage with explicit pathspecs (concurrent writers share this worktree). No push, release or foreign-store mutation. At handoff attach exact revisions, commands and results, oracle manifest hashes and declared caveats; unresolved criteria keep the packet open.
set.title: STP-P3.01: WorldTransform ADT, PushAvailability, provenance, resample entry point
